limitations: WEB-04 owns schema-driven manual dry-run input and the accepted admission receipt. WEB-05 owns approval decisions, WEB-06 owns the SPA run timeline and artifact viewer, WEB-07 owns the narrow semantic tree, and WEB-08 owns exhaustive accessibility acceptance.

The accepted receipt links to the authoritative run API resource and explicitly does not claim execution, publication, delivery, or completion. A dedicated run timeline route does not exist until WEB-06.

The browser gate uses real hierarchy, instance-detail, session, status, and production Vite boundaries. It overlays only deterministic same-origin dry-run 422 and 202 POST responses because default create_app intentionally has no manual-work service composition.

Sensitive input remains in controlled React memory while the form is open and is cleared after acceptance. Browser storage, URL state, query caches, logs, and error messages do not receive submitted values.
Client validation is advisory. The server remains authoritative for the same schema, authorization, idempotency, admission, approval, and external-effect controls.
